site.aboutBody:
Rooted in Srinagar, Kashmir Holdings is a diversified enterprise focused on creating sustainable value across Kashmir and beyond. Our vision is to bring together local expertise, modern technology, strategic opportunities, and responsible business practices to build businesses with long-term potential.

Our interests span real estate, agriculture and orchard produce, Kashmiri products, enterprise technology, business consulting, strategic investments, and emerging ventures. Across every vertical, we aim to combine Kashmir’s unique strengths with modern thinking to create trusted solutions, meaningful opportunities, and lasting value.
From helping clients discover the right property and bringing authentic Kashmiri products to wider markets, to enabling businesses through Odoo, Sage, Zoho Books, ERP solutions, automation, and digital transformation, Kashmir Holdings works across diverse sectors with a common focus on quality, integrity, and sustainable growth.

Our vision is to build a trusted and forward-looking business group that contributes to Kashmir’s growth while creating value for the future.
